text.content:
The nomads who rebuilt Night City, and still run its roads.

Kind: Nomad nation
Base: The Aldecaldo Camp (#54), a moving town east of the city; welcome at the East Bay Terminal and Red Dirt in Arroyo
Leadership: Rosa Aldecaldo, matriarch. Saul Bright is a rising lieutenant
Purpose: Keeping the family free, fed and moving, and getting the Free City to treat the families as partners

Formed in 1993 when residents of East Los Angeles packed up and left, the Aldecaldos are the nomads you'll meet most around Night City. In the Time of the Red they led the nomad families who hauled in the materials to rebuild the city; the families camped in Rancho Coronado, and have since been pushed out past the dam.

They run the Badlands trade routes the city still depends on. A family's road costs 50eb per vehicle per day, or a favor, and friends of the family ride free. The Aldecaldo Camp is a town of trucks, trailers and workshops guarded by Aldecaldo Peacekeepers, with the best mechanics in California; you're welcome if you're polite and useful.

You don't join a nomad family the way you join a gang. You marry in, are born in, or earn it over years on the road.

People

  • Rosa Aldecaldo (Nomad 9), the matriarch. Wants the Free City to treat the families like the partners they are, and isn't holding her breath.
  • Saul Bright (Nomad 6), a young lieutenant, steady and careful. The camp says he'll lead the family one day; Saul says nothing.
  • Mitch "Dakota" Calloway (Nomad 6), the family's man at the East Bay Terminal. Knows every load that comes in and who it's for.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.27; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 11, 13
